recipe.emission: the day's feature-valid keys; on a 25-hour day both keys of the repeated hour take that slot's forecast
recipe.ensemble: four best distinct configurations x two seeds; per-level median of the eight members' EUR/MWh quantiles (mean of the two middle values); p50 = central = D2
recipe.guards: winsorisation of continuous inputs at the training rows' (0.005, 0.995) quantiles; the cap at +-1.25 x max|z| on the member's training rows (before any asinh); sorting of crossings; every activation counted
recipe.head: xi = o1, lambda = softplus(o2) + 1e-3, gamma = o3, delta = softplus(o4) + 0.05, per local-hour slot
recipe.held_out_weeks: the member's seeded random 20% (rounded, at least one) of the whole Monday-Sunday weeks inside [window start, D-7); PCG64(SeedSequence([seed, 0x5EED]))
recipe.loss: first 20 epochs NLL only; then kappa*NLL + (1-kappa)*mean pinball over the 19-level grid [0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8, 0.85, 0.9, 0.95, 0.975]; + l1*sum|W| + l2*sum W^2 over weight matrices; present slots only; rows weighted by recency (mean 1)
recipe.optimizer: Adam {'beta1': 0.9, 'beta2': 0.999, 'eps': 1e-08} in PyTorch's update order; Glorot-uniform init, zero biases, output biases at lambda = delta = 1
recipe.stopping: mean pinball over the seven scored levels in EUR/MWh after inversion and the cap, on the held-out weeks, after every epoch from 21; patience 50; maximum 1000 epochs; best epoch kept (strict improvement); a nonfinite loss stops training and keeps the best epoch (recorded)
recipe.window: [max(2019-01-01, D-728), D) day rows with an eligible target slot and finite origin statistics; pre-fold fits leave out every delivery day without a frozen weather record (§23.6)

sampler: cp24.sampler (seed SeedSequence([24, round, fold_index, 0x5A3])); fit seeds cp24.sampler.fit_seed; ensemble seeds cp24.sampler.member_seeds
